end.summary:
Discussed observations, hypotheses, laws and theories using ant behaviour and temperature examples.
Tara identified an observation from ants walking one behind another.
Tara explained a hypothesis about ants losing their line when an obstacle blocks the smell trail.
They correctly distinguished observation, hypothesis, law and theory in two unaided attempts.
Teach-back was not passed; the lesson ended when Tara reported feeling tired and bored.
end.parentNote: Asha practised sorting statements into observation, hypothesis, law and theory. Tara explained the ant example using a possible smell trail and correctly identified a repeated pattern as a law in the practice questions. Tara was unsure about the temperature example, and this was not revisited before the lesson ended. At home, try sorting three everyday statements into “what was noticed,” “what might explain it,” and “a pattern that keeps repeating.”
